title: prefill-playbook-compiler-and-quant-profile-registry
author: Priya Menon
description:
Motivation: We need a deterministic, auditable way to convert high-level prefill/batch playbooks (tenant-facing YAML) into concrete defaults, quantization profile bindings, and simulated unit-econ estimates. This PR adds a Playbook Compiler service + CLI and a light-weight Quant Profile Registry to centralize presets used by Redwood Optimize and the Dedicated autoscaler.

Summary of changes: adds a compile-time validation pipeline for playbooks, a rules engine that materializes per-tenant candidate defaults, a simulation step that produces unit-econ deltas (cost/latency/quality), and a small HTTP registry for quant presets. Also includes a CLI (rwctl playbook compile/export) for SREs and solutions engineers to produce deterministic artifacts for rollouts.

What this solves: previously defaults were scattered across heuristics in runtime and the Console; teams had to run ad-hoc sims. The new compiler gives repeatable outputs, migration paths, and a discoverable registry of quant profiles that can be referenced by name from policies. This reduces onboarding friction and makes canarying safer.

Scope: server-side Go service (pkg/playbook-compiler), a CLI shim in tools/rwctl, small Express-compatible admin API (server/admin/quant-registry) for CRUD on quant presets, unit and integration tests, docs (docs/playbooks/compile.md), and e2e simulation harness (tests/e2e/prefill-sim).

Design notes: playbooks are validated against a JSON Schema; compiler runs three phases: 1) normalize (resolve tenant overrides and feature flags), 2) synthesize defaults (batch sizes, cache TTLs, prefill thresholds, quant profile binding), 3) simulate (synthetic request stream to estimate per-token unit-econ and 95th latency). Output is a signed artifact (v1) that can be consumed by Dedicated/Private agents or uploaded to Console as a rollout candidate.

Backward compatibility and migration: the compiler emits 'legacy_mappings' for fields still consumed by older runtime versions. The quant registry supports both named profiles and raw profile blobs; runtime will fall back to inline profile if registry lookup fails. Migration docs included.

Testing: added 78 unit tests, 6 integration tests that run a small simulated workload, and a smoke test for the CLI. CI initially failed due to a time-sensitive e2e flake; added deterministic seed and improved test isolation.

Security: registry API requires admin token; payloads are validated and size-limited. No secrets stored.

Checklist: - [x] Compiler service implemented - [x] CLI for compile/export - [x] Quant registry API and DB migration - [x] Tests and simulation harness - [x] Docs and migration guide - [x] Telemetry (metrics: compiler_runs, compile_errors, sim_estimates_emitted)

Commits: see commits list field for per-commit descriptions.

Merge notes: squash-merged after CI green and approvals from Ethan and Marta. The new service is feature-flagged (prefill.compiler_v1) and will be enabled for internal sandbox tenants first.

Follow-ups: - wire Console UI to present compiled candidates (follow-up ENG-1933) - add a periodic garbage-collector for stale quant presets (ENG-1998)

review_thread: Ethan Cole: Overall looks good. A few nit comments on rule ordering and an edge-case where tenant overrides might wipe prefill thresholds. Please add a test for that case.
Priya Menon (author): Added test 'TenantOverridePreservePrefill' and updated normalization to preserve explicit low-level overrides. Pushed fix in c7d8f11.
Marta Alvarez: The simulation estimates look reasonable, but we should be careful exposing raw latency outputs in logs. Suggest we only ship aggregated percentiles (p50/p95) to telemetry.
Priya Menon: Switched telemetry to emit p50/p95 and a 'sim_bucket' histogram. Updated metrics and docs.
Jun Park: Small nit: prefer semantic version in artifact name (playbook-artifact:v1) to make future upgrades explicit.
Priya Menon: Done - artifacts now include semantic version and compiler git SHA.
ci_log_summary: CI: initial run - unit tests passed, e2e prefills failed (flaky seed). Reran with deterministic seed; all checks passed. Lint fixed (gofmt) on last push.
release_notes: Introduce Playbook Compiler (v1) and Quant Profile Registry: deterministic compilation of tenant playbooks into rollout artifacts, simulation-based unit-econ estimates, and a discoverable registry for quant presets. Feature-flagged rollout; see docs/playbooks/compile.md for migration steps and RWCTL usage.
notes_for_release_manager: Feature is behind boolean flag 'prefill.compiler_v1'. Recommend enabling in sandbox namespace for 2 weeks, monitor metrics: compiler_runs, compile_errors, sim_estimates_emitted, and any spike in Dedicated autoscaler fallbacks.
security_review: admin-only API for registry, input validation added, size limits enforced; security reviewed by SRE team (ticket SUP-4312).
